name: Krzysztof Nowak
bio: Krzysztof's journey into motorsport began later in life, after spending years managing logistics for a regional construction firm. He always had a passion for racing, attending local rallies with his father as a boy. After a restructuring at his old company, Krzysztof decided to pursue his dream, taking a significant pay cut to enter the motorsport world. He brings a methodical and detail-oriented approach to logistics, ensuring every component and piece of equipment arrives where it needs to be, on time. His calm demeanor is an asset, especially when dealing with the inevitable last-minute changes and unforeseen challenges of race day logistics. He's eager to prove himself and grow within the team.

physical.description: Krzysztof is a stout man of average height, with a kind face and a practical demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook and pen.
Insists on using physical maps alongside GPS, 'just in case'.
Has a habit of humming quietly while organizing shipments.
